summary: RFC-0049 OQ-8 (AISDLC-1444 OQ-A): promotion bar for operator-question.auto-answer

options.description: Existing relax bar plus deviation test (>=80% correct on >=20 questions where the operator did not pick Recommended), veto-rate demotion (>2 of last 20 enforced -> shadow), labels count at 28 days old, recommended option recorded (AISDLC-1447), free-text Other = deviation with label unknown

body: Is the existing relax bar (n>=50, act-band precision >=95%, no override) enough for answering an operator question on the operator's behalf, when the label is the operator's own answer and the operator picks the session's Recommended option 92% of the time?
